definition: A socially assistive robot (SAR) aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions..
details: A socially assistive robot (SAR) aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions.

explainer.lead: A socially assistive robot (SAR) aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions. It matters because assistance can come from interaction, not manipulation.

tiers.eli5: A robot helper that helps you by talking and interacting with you, not by picking things up.
tiers.practitioner: The key design point is that the aid is delivered through social engagement; a pitfall is expecting it to perform physical tasks.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as a robot that aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions.

explainer.example: A SAR supporting a user by engaging and encouraging them socially, without performing any physical task, fits the definition.
